$comment: Manual, reviewed corrections to the generated mapping. build-mapping.mjs applies these on every run, so they survive regeneration. Keys are master topic IDs (mt.<library topic id>). Requirement keys, from least to most specific: '*', '@<category>', '@<category>:<stageClass>', '<examId>', '<examId>/<stageId>'.

verification.note: Same canonical library topic in all 9 exams; subtopic coverage reviewed 2026-11-20.

@ssc.depthDescription: Standard to advanced arithmetic problems: successive change, product constancy, applications.

ssc-cgl/tier2-paper1.depthDescription: Advanced multi-step percentage problems (Tier-II Mathematical Abilities).

@banking:prelims.depthDescription: Speed-based calculations: percentage–fraction equivalents, quick approximation, one-step word problems.

@banking:mains.depthDescription: Complex applications and DI-related percentage calculations (caselets, multi-chart DI).

mt.ga.current-affairs.note: Same topic, but the time window differs (SSC ≈ 6–12 months, banking ≈ 3–6 months with banking/economy focus). Coverage can be shared; the status per exam is kept separate.

verification.note: SSC tests letter/number/symbol coding; banking tests word/sentence (Chinese) and conditional coding. Shared at subtopic level only (letter, number).
Same assessment type, but each bank's interview (SBI PO GE + interview, IBPS PO, RRB PO) is prepared separately.
Only shareable if both exams were applied for in a state with the same local language; review per candidate.
Self-report profiling; nothing to learn or share across exams.

add.note: Banking quant number series vs SSC reasoning number series: same skill, tested in different sections.
Same question format (statement sufficiency), different subject content.
